typeProperties.script:
source(output(
		busDate as date,
		failType as string,
		clientNbr as string,
		product as string,
		productTypeCode as string,
		superProductCode as string,
		depo as string,
		reportGroup as string,
		reportCategory as string,
		sodFailCnt as integer,
		eodFailCnt as integer,
		settledFails as integer,
		zeroDaySettled as integer,
		overallSettledCnt as integer,
		openforSettToday as integer,
		ageSummation as integer,
		aveAge as integer,
		clearancePercent as decimal(18,16),
		failPercent as decimal(18,16)
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> OLEDBSource
OLEDBSource derive({Copy of clearancePercent} = clearancePercent,
		{Copy of failPercent} = failPercent) ~> DataConversion
DataConversion sink(input(
		openforSettToday as string,
		product as string,
		failType as string,
		overallSettledCnt as string,
		failPercent as string,
		clearancePercent as string,
		depo as string,
		settledFails as string,
		ageSummation as string,
		sodFailCnt as string,
		busDate as string,
		reportGroup as string,
		clientNbr as string,
		reportCategory as string,
		zeroDaySettled as string,
		superProductCode as string,
		aveAge as string,
		productTypeCode as string,
		eodFailCnt as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		openforSettToday,
		product,
		failType,
		overallSettledCnt,
		failPercent = {Copy of failPercent},
		clearancePercent = {Copy of clearancePercent},
		depo,
		settledFails,
		ageSummation,
		sodFailCnt,
		busDate,
		reportGroup,
		clientNbr,
		reportCategory,
		zeroDaySettled,
		superProductCode,
		aveAge,
		productTypeCode,
		eodFailCnt)) ~> FlatFileDestination
